howItWorks.label: How It Works
howItWorks.heading: Up and training in minutes
howItWorks.step0desc: Open the Program tab and create a workout template. Add exercises from 95 built-in options, set target reps, weight, and rest time. Assign the template to a day of the week.
howItWorks.step1desc: Tap Start Workout from the Dashboard or your Watch. Your program loads instantly — no setup, no waiting.
howItWorks.step2desc: Complete each set, adjust reps and weight on the fly. The rest timer fires automatically. Skip it or add time — your call. Log everything from your Watch without touching your phone.
howItWorks.step3desc: After saving, your volume and strength progression charts update. Personal records are detected automatically. Pull up History to review any past session in full detail.

privacySection.label: Privacy
privacySection.heading: Your data never leaves your device
privacySection.subtitle: iGymBro was built on a simple principle: your training data belongs to you. No backend. No tracking. No exceptions.
privacySection.pillar0desc: iGymBro makes zero network requests. Everything runs locally on your device using Apple's SwiftData framework.
privacySection.pillar1desc: Zero sign-up friction. Launch the app and start training — no email, no password, no personal information ever collected.
privacySection.pillar2desc: The app contains no third-party SDKs for analytics, advertising, A/B testing, or crash reporting. None.
privacySection.pillar3desc: iPhone and Apple Watch communicate via Apple's WatchConnectivity — a direct, encrypted, peer-to-peer connection. No data passes through any external server.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.heading: Common questions
faq.0a: Yes. iGymBro is free to download with no in-app purchases and no subscription. All features — including the Apple Watch app — are included.
faq.1q: Do I need an Apple Watch to use iGymBro?
faq.1a: No. The iPhone app is fully self-contained. The Apple Watch companion enhances the experience by letting you log sets from your wrist, but it is entirely optional.
faq.2a: The Apple Watch companion requires watchOS 10 or later. The iPhone app requires iOS 17 or later.
faq.3q: Does iGymBro sync to iCloud or the internet?
faq.3a: No. iGymBro is fully offline. All workout data is stored on your device using Apple's SwiftData framework. Nothing is ever uploaded anywhere.
faq.4q: Does HealthKit need to be enabled?
faq.4a: No. HealthKit access is optional. If granted, iGymBro displays real-time heart rate and calories during workouts and writes completed sessions to Apple Health. All core features work without it.
faq.5a: iGymBro is fully localized in 10 languages: English, Bulgarian, Spanish, German, Italian, French, Chinese (Simplified), Japanese, Hindi, and Russian — including all exercise names and instructions.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.summary0: All data stays on your device. iGymBro does not have a backend server, does not create user accounts, and does not transmit any personal data over the internet.
privacyPage.summary1: No third-party tracking. The App contains no analytics SDKs, advertising networks, or crash-reporting services.
privacyPage.summary2: HealthKit data is optional. Heart rate and calorie data are only accessed with your explicit permission and are never shared outside of Apple's frameworks.
privacyPage.s1intro: All data is stored locally on your device using Apple's SwiftData framework (on-device SQLite database). Nothing is uploaded to any server.
privacyPage.s1workout0: Workout templates you create (exercise names, sets, reps, target weights, rest periods)
privacyPage.s1workout1: Completed workout sessions (date, duration, exercises performed, actual weights and reps, session notes)
privacyPage.s1workout2: Personal records (maximum weight, maximum reps, maximum volume per exercise)
privacyPage.s1note: None of the above ever leaves your device.
privacyPage.s2intro: The App integrates with Apple HealthKit solely to enhance your workout experience. This requires your explicit permission, which you can grant or revoke at any time in
privacyPage.s2row0purpose: Display real-time heart rate during active workouts
privacyPage.s2row1purpose: Show calorie burn during workouts; save workout calorie data to Health
privacyPage.s2row2purpose: Log completed strength training sessions to your Health app
privacyPage.s2optional: HealthKit integration is fully optional. If you decline or revoke HealthKit permission, all core features continue to work normally.
privacyPage.s3body: If you use the Apple Watch companion app, workout templates and your weekly schedule are transferred from your iPhone to your Apple Watch using Apple's WatchConnectivity framework. This is a direct, encrypted, device-to-device connection — data does not pass through any external server. Completed workouts recorded on your Apple Watch are transferred back to your iPhone through the same mechanism.
privacyPage.s4body: The App may request permission to send local notifications for scheduled workout reminders. These notifications are generated entirely on your device — no notification content is sent to any server. You can manage notification permissions in Settings → Notifications → iGymBro.
privacyPage.s5item0: No account or registration — the App does not require you to create an account or provide any personal information.
privacyPage.s5item1: No location data — the App does not access or use your location.
privacyPage.s5item2: No camera or microphone — the App does not access your camera or microphone.
privacyPage.s5item3: No contacts or calendar — the App does not access your contacts or calendar.
privacyPage.s5item4: No network requests — the App makes no outbound network connections.
privacyPage.s5item5: No analytics or advertising — the App contains no third-party SDKs for analytics, advertising, A/B testing, or crash reporting.
privacyPage.s5item6: No behavioral tracking — the App does not track how you use it and does not share usage data with anyone.
privacyPage.s6p1: Your data is retained on your device for as long as you use the App or until you delete it.
privacyPage.s6p2: To permanently delete all App data, uninstall iGymBro from your device. This removes the local SwiftData database and all associated workout history, templates, personal records, and preferences.
privacyPage.s6p3: To remove workout data from Apple Health, open the Health app and navigate to Browse → Workouts, or go to Settings → Privacy & Security → Health → iGymBro and revoke access.
privacyPage.s7body: iGymBro does not knowingly collect any information from children under the age of 13. The App collects no personal information from any user, so there is no information to collect from minors either.
privacyPage.s8body: If the App's data practices change materially, an updated Privacy Policy will be included in the next App Store release and reflected in the "Last updated" date at the top of this page.
